sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression quantified by FLAG epitope detection in Expi293F cells; receptor detected at the cell surface. Functional assays not reported for this construct.
sites.rationale: PROKR1 has no endogenous signal peptide (raw topology begins O, extracellular residues 1–62). The library construct prepends an exogenous HA signal sequence followed by FLAG before GPCR residue 1; after signal cleavage the FLAG sits at the extracellular N-terminus, placing the junction at insert_after_residue=0 (before M1). This is the only extracellular terminus of this 7-TM receptor, so the position is topology-derived. The N-terminal extracellular domain spans 62 residues, providing ample space ≥3 residues from TM1 (which begins at residue 63). PRESTO-Tango library construct: exogenous HA signal sequence (MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA) followed by FLAG tag, then PROKR1 (one of 215 GPCRs), expressed in Expi293F cells; FLAG used to detect and quantify surface-displayed receptor.

sources.claim: All GPCRs except CALCRL and FZD4, FZD5, FZD6, and FZD10 relied on the codon-optimized PRESTO-Tango library of signal sequence-FLAG-GPCRs as a starting point to generate 215 FLAG-GPCR-1D4 constructs, with the FLAG tag (DYKDDDDA) following the HA signal sequence MKTIIALSYIFCLVFA.

literature_notes: L1 and L2 both describe the same PRESTO-Tango FLAG-GPCR-1D4 library; L1 is cited as the primary supporting line. The 1D4 tag in that same construct is appended to the C-terminus of PROKR1 (residue 393), which is intracellular (topology: INTRACELLULAR 344–393) and is therefore recorded in other_positions. L3 describes a zebrafish PKR1 ortholog (zPKR1-FLAG) where the '-FLAG' suffix convention indicates C-terminal placement, also intracellular. L4 describes zPKR1 cloned into pEGFP-N1, which appends GFP C-terminally — again intracellular. L5 and L6 describe PKR1-rLuc, a C-terminal Renilla luciferase fusion used in BRET assays — intracellular. No ledger line reports a tag inserted into any extracellular loop (ECL1 120–138, ECL2 200–232, ECL3 306–322) of PROKR1 or a close ortholog; no internal extracellular sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: 1D4 tag appended to the C-terminus of PROKR1 in the PRESTO-Tango library construct; C-terminus falls in the intracellular region (topology: INTRACELLULAR 344–393).

Zebrafish PKR1 ortholog (zPKR1-FLAG) expressed in CHO cells; '-FLAG' suffix indicates C-terminal tag, which is intracellular in this GPCR; used for co-precipitation with zMRAP2a-His, not surface labelling.
Zebrafish PKR1 cloned into pEGFP-N1 (C-terminal GFP fusion); C-terminus is intracellular; construct used for expression studies.
PKR1-rLuc: C-terminal Renilla luciferase fusion used in BRET assays to monitor β-arrestin-2 recruitment; C-terminus is intracellular.
